# IntraZone Digital Marketing

> IntraZone is an independent digital marketing business in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, run by Jason Merkel, Digital Marketing Strategist. It builds websites and handles local SEO, social media, Google Ads and Google Ad Grants for small businesses and nonprofits. All prices are in CAD.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://intrazone.ca/): services, prices, work, FAQ and the free quote form
- [Portfolio](https://intrazone.ca/portfolio/): Jason Merkel's portfolio, case studies, skills and experience

## Monthly plans (12-month commitment, setup fees waived)

- Web Design: $79/month ($948 total), or $599 paid once
- Local SEO: $249/month
- Google Ad Grant Management: $299/month, for eligible nonprofits
- Social Media Management: from $349/month

## One-time website packages

- Starter Website: $599 (1 page)
- Business Website: $1,299 (up to 5 pages)
- Premium Website: $4,999 (custom design, up to 8 pages)
